cards.definition: Expressing polite doubt (मुझे पूरी तरह यक़ीन नहीं है)
cards.exampleSentence: I'm not entirely convinced this will scale.

cards.definition: A polite way to disagree (मुझे अफ़सोस है, मैं असहमत हूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: I'm afraid I disagree with that estimate.

cards.definition: I'll say that in a clearer way (मैं इसे दूसरे ढंग से कहता हूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: Let me rephrase that so it's less confusing.

cards.definition: I'll repeat what I understood (मैं जो समझा, दोहराता हूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: Let me play that back to make sure I've got it.

cards.definition: Acknowledging a valid worry (यह एक जायज़ चिंता है)
cards.exampleSentence: That's a fair concern; we'll add a safeguard.

cards.definition: Saying a point is open to argument (यह बहस का विषय है)
cards.exampleSentence: That's debatable; others have seen different results.

cards.definition: Introducing a reasoned opinion (मेरा तर्क है कि)
cards.exampleSentence: I'd argue that maintainability matters more than speed here.

cards.definition: Politely proposing an idea (मेरा सुझाव होगा)
cards.exampleSentence: I'd suggest we run a smaller pilot first.

cards.definition: Formally advising a course of action (मैं सलाह दूँगा)
cards.exampleSentence: I'd recommend adding retries before launch.

cards.definition: Politely offering a plan (क्या मैं एक प्रस्ताव रखूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: May I propose a phased rollout?

cards.definition: Introducing a hypothetical idea (क्यों न हम ... करें)
cards.exampleSentence: What if we split the job into two stages?

cards.definition: Casually suggesting an option (... कैसा रहेगा)
cards.exampleSentence: How about we review this on Thursday?

cards.definition: Suggesting an option as a question (क्या यह उचित होगा कि)
cards.exampleSentence: Would it make sense to wait for the vendor's fix?

cards.definition: Questioning whether an effort is justified (क्या ... करना फ़ायदेमंद है)
cards.exampleSentence: Is it worth rewriting the module now?

cards.definition: Asking for the reason behind a decision (इसके पीछे तर्क क्या है)
cards.exampleSentence: What's the rationale behind the new schema?

cards.definition: Asking what the main goal is (हम किस चीज़ को सबसे अहम मान रहे हैं)
cards.exampleSentence: What are we optimising for: speed or cost?

cards.definition: Asking about consequences (इसका क्या असर होगा)
cards.exampleSentence: What's the impact on downstream consumers?

cards.definition: Asking about the most negative outcome (सबसे बुरा परिणाम क्या हो सकता है)
cards.exampleSentence: What's the worst case if the vendor is late?

cards.definition: Asking what is required to achieve something (इसके लिए क्या चाहिए होगा)
cards.exampleSentence: What would it take to finish by Friday?

cards.definition: Asking about current status (हम किस स्थिति में हैं)
cards.exampleSentence: Where do we stand on the security review?

cards.definition: Asking about the situation after new information (तो अब हमारी स्थिति क्या है)
cards.exampleSentence: Where does that leave us on the timeline?

cards.definition: Asking if something prevents progress (क्या यह रुकावट है)
cards.exampleSentence: Is that a blocker or just a nice-to-have?

cards.word: can we get a quick show of hands
cards.definition: Asking participants to vote visibly (क्या हाथ उठाकर राय ले सकते हैं)
cards.exampleSentence: Can we get a quick show of hands on option B?

cards.definition: Asking whether something is familiar (क्या यह याद आता है)
cards.exampleSentence: Does the name of that vendor ring a bell?

cards.definition: Checking understanding (क्या यह समझ में आया)
cards.exampleSentence: Does that make sense, or should I draw it?

cards.definition: Checking that you are being understood (क्या मैं स्पष्ट बोल रहा हूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: Am I making sense, or should I explain differently?

cards.word: are we on the same page
cards.definition: Checking shared understanding (क्या हम एक ही समझ पर हैं)
cards.exampleSentence: Are we on the same page about the deadline?

cards.definition: Inviting disagreement before deciding (क्या किसी को आपत्ति है)
cards.exampleSentence: Does anyone have any objections to moving the release?

cards.definition: Politely contributing to a discussion (मैं कुछ जोड़ना चाहूँगा)
cards.exampleSentence: I'd like to add that we also need a rollback plan.

cards.definition: Politely interjecting to contribute (यदि मैं बस एक बात जोड़ सकूँ)
cards.exampleSentence: If I could just add one point on security.

cards.definition: Raising a point before changing topics (आगे बढ़ने से पहले)
cards.exampleSentence: Before we move on, can I raise one concern?

cards.word: going back to your earlier point
cards.definition: Returning to a previously mentioned idea (आपकी पिछली बात पर लौटते हुए)
cards.exampleSentence: Going back to your earlier point, we should log more.

cards.definition: Returning to a topic (वापस ... पर आते हुए)
cards.exampleSentence: To go back to the cost question, we have two options.

cards.definition: Changing to the next topic (अगले विषय पर आते हुए)
cards.exampleSentence: Moving on to the next item, the budget.

cards.definition: Linking to something just mentioned (इसी की बात करें तो)
cards.exampleSentence: Speaking of which, the audit is due next week.

cards.definition: Introducing a connected point (इसी से जुड़ी बात)
cards.exampleSentence: On a related note, our alerts need tuning.

cards.definition: Adding a casual extra point (वैसे)
cards.exampleSentence: By the way, the vendor changed their schema.

cards.definition: Adding a point that is not central (संयोग से / प्रसंगवश)
cards.exampleSentence: Incidentally, that library is deprecated.

cards.definition: A brief statement of your opinion (संक्षेप में मेरी राय)
cards.exampleSentence: In a nutshell, my view is that we should wait.

cards.definition: Giving a final short summary (सारांश में)
cards.exampleSentence: To sum up, we need more data before deciding.

cards.definition: Moving towards a conclusion (इसे समेटते हुए)
cards.exampleSentence: To wrap this up, here are the three action items.
